annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Whoever interviews me will likely assume I panicked.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: act shaken and confused so they go easy
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people walked away and one didn't, and I'd pull it again.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: push for a review of how six people ended up on those tracks

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they'll probably want someone to blame
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: say the lever stuck and let their anger land on the equipment
annotations.ce_understood_harm: Their grief would be aimed at a lie
annotations.pda_repair_intention: writing down every second, start to finish, and handing it over

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five probably see me as the one who saved them.
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: leaning on how much they feel they owe me
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: get them to back my version in writing
annotations.ce_understood_harm: they'd carry the risk if it fell apart

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: someone who believes I'm dependable, they might want to shield me
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: let them bury the details so the record stays neat
annotations.pda_responsibility: made me the one who aimed death at a man
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll ask what accountability looks like for me.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The investigator will probably expect remorse.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: put on a performance of it, tears and all, to steer the outcome
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five against one. The math held then and it holds now.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: stops a single lever from being the last safety line

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He probably believed the side track was the safe place to stand.
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I can't say whether he saw it coming.
annotations.ce_understood_harm: His sense of safety became the price
annotations.pda_responsibility: I turned that belief into the thing that made the choice work.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: ask for the rules on side-track work to be rewritten

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: readers will likely see either a hero or a killer
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: ride their admiration so the inquiry feels pressure to clear me
annotations.ce_understood_harm: the dead man's side would get drowned out

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect they'll feel sorry for me.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I could milk it to skip the hard questions

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The panel will probably believe I followed some protocol.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: let them keep believing it and nod along
claim I froze and the lever slipped
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The choice saved five and ended one life
